battery_power.description: Battery drain, rapid discharge, power management, charging failure, or unexpected shutdowns.
battery_power.in_scope: Battery health, charging cables, fast drain, phone dying above 1%, overheating while charging.
battery_power.out_of_scope: General phone slowness or app freezing without battery mention.
battery_power.decision_boundary: Classify as battery_power if battery life, drain, or charging is explicitly mentioned.

software_update.description: Issues installing, downloading, verifying, or rolling back iOS/macOS updates or iTunes backup/restore.
software_update.in_scope: Update verification hang, installation errors, iTunes update errors, release inquiries, reverting update.
software_update.out_of_scope: Specific bugs caused by an update (e.g. battery drain or keyboard glitch).
software_update.decision_boundary: If customer asks how/when to update, or update failed to install/download, classify as software_update.

performance_system.description: System sluggishness, freezing touchscreen, app crashes, unexpected lag, or unresponsiveness.
performance_system.in_scope: Apps closing spontaneously, touchscreen freezing, slow typing/navigation, spinning wheel.
performance_system.out_of_scope: Physical screen cracking, pure battery drain, or keyboard autocorrect letter substitution.
performance_system.decision_boundary: Classify as performance_system when the primary complaint is software unresponsiveness, freezing, or app crashes.

keyboard_typing.description: Autocorrect bugs (letter i becoming question mark box), keyboard lag, predictive text or dictation failures.
keyboard_typing.in_scope: Question mark box bug, keyboard freezing/lag, predictive emoji issues, autocorrect capitalization glitches.
keyboard_typing.out_of_scope: General app freezing outside of text entry.
keyboard_typing.decision_boundary: Specific to text entry, keyboard responsiveness, predictive text, and autocorrect anomalies.

account_billing.description: Apple ID credentials, iCloud storage/sync, passwords, App Store purchases, and subscription charges.
account_billing.in_scope: Password resets, 2FA codes, account lockout, subscription cancellations, refund requests, iCloud full warnings.
account_billing.decision_boundary: Involves personal credentials, Apple ID authentication, or financial/subscription transactions.

hardware_audio_display.description: Physical hardware damage, cracked display, black screen, camera failure, microphone, speaker, or headphone issues.
hardware_audio_display.in_scope: Broken glass, OLED lines, camera black screen, distorted speaker sound, mic not working, headphone dongle defect.
hardware_audio_display.out_of_scope: Software touchscreen lag without physical damage.
hardware_audio_display.decision_boundary: Classify here if physical components (screen, camera, speaker, mic, buttons, audio ports) fail or are damaged.

connectivity_network.description: Wi-Fi disconnects, Bluetooth pairing failures, cellular signal drops, No Service errors, or carrier data.
connectivity_network.in_scope: Cannot join Wi-Fi, grayed out toggle, Bluetooth dropouts, dropped cellular calls, No Service, Hotspot.
connectivity_network.out_of_scope: App Store download speed issues without network disconnection.
connectivity_network.decision_boundary: Involves wireless protocols (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Cellular, AirDrop) or cellular carrier network access.

general_inquiry_other.description: General inquiries, store hours, reservations, courtesy messages, mid-thread confirmations, or conversational follow-ups.
general_inquiry_other.in_scope: Pre-order inquiries, store location questions, courtesy ("thanks", "done"), short answers ("yes", "iPhone 7"), unspecific complaints.
general_inquiry_other.out_of_scope: Inquiries with specific technical or account failure symptoms.
general_inquiry_other.decision_boundary: Fallback class for generic inquiries, social acknowledgements, or messages lacking specific technical domain symptoms.
